concern: nigehbaan (guardian) is the wrong word; Urdu has نگراں (nigraan, overseer), a different word already used elsewhere in the corpus (42:6, 12:11/65) as "nigraan"/"nigraani", not نگہبان
suggestion: yaqeenan Allah Taala bandon ka nigraan hai

concern: de dein breaks R2 (nasal verb forms stay single-vowel, never -ein); every other occurrence of this exact compound verb in the corpus, including the parallel verse 10:46 ("hum aap ko wafat de den"), uses de den
suggestion: hum aap ko wafaat de den
